name: taskflow
description: TaskFlow - ứng dụng quản lý công việc (web, admin: React + Vite; api: Express + MongoDB)
author: Duy An (https://github.com/NayuD06)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev" "npm --prefix admin run dev"
